camel_example: aliyun csas CreateBackendReport --region cn-hangzhou --ReportObjects.1.DevType windows --PolicyType PrivateAccessBlock --ReportObjects.1.DeviceType usbStorage --ReportObjects.1.SoftwareId 'swb-c717ee5161450000' --ValidityType FixedTime --ReportObjects.1.ReportDomain '0.example.com' --ReportObjects.1.FileMd5 c936226c4745125b5786527d205a0000 --EndTimestamp 1788192000 --ReportObjects.1.Scope Channel --ReportObjects.1.ApplicationId 'pa-app-00000000000000001234' --Targets.1.UserId su_8548af20c3b30e931e75cd847a4c0000 --Reason '项目临时访问' --method POST --force
name: CreateBackendReport

parameters.help_en:
The filing policy type. Valid values:
PrivateAccessBlock: private access.
DomainWhitelist: domain name whitelist.
DomainBlacklist: domain name blacklist.
SoftwareBlock: software blocking.
DlpSend: file outbound transfer.
PeripheralBlock: peripheral control
parameters.help_zh:
报备策略类型。取值：
PrivateAccessBlock：内网访问。
DomainWhitelist：域名白名单。
DomainBlacklist：域名黑名单。
SoftwareBlock：软件禁用。
DlpSend：文件外发。
PeripheralBlock：外设管控
parameters.name: policy_type

fields.help_en: The SASE user ID. You can call ListUsers to query the ID
fields.help_zh: SASE 用户 ID。可通过 ListUsers 查询
fields.name: user_id

parameters.help_en: The list of filing users, serialized in Flat format. You can specify 1 to 100 users. Only specific SASE users under the current Alibaba Cloud account are supported. The product of the number of deduplicated users and the number of filing objects cannot exceed 100
parameters.help_zh: 报备用户列表，使用 Flat 序列化格式。支持 1~100 个用户；仅支持当前阿里云账号下的具体 SASE 用户。去重后的用户数与报备对象数的乘积不能大于 100
parameters.name: targets

fields.help_en: The private access application ID. This parameter is required when PolicyType is set to PrivateAccessBlock. You can call ListPrivateAccessApplications to query the ID
fields.help_zh: 内网应用 ID。当 PolicyType 取值为 PrivateAccessBlock 时必填。可通过 ListPrivateAccessApplications 查询
fields.name: application_id

fields.help_en:
The endpoint operating system. This parameter is required when PolicyType is set to PeripheralBlock. Valid values:
windows: Windows.
macOS: macOS
fields.help_zh:
终端操作系统。当 PolicyType 取值为 PeripheralBlock 时必填。取值：
windows：Windows。
macOS：macOS
fields.name: dev_type

fields.help_en: The peripheral channel. This parameter is required when PolicyType is set to PeripheralBlock. Windows supports usbStorage, printer, mobile, cardReader, cdrom, and bluetooth. macOS supports usbStorage, airDrop, mobile, and bluetooth
fields.help_zh: 外设渠道。当 PolicyType 取值为 PeripheralBlock 时必填。Windows 支持 usbStorage、printer、mobile、cardReader、cdrom、bluetooth；macOS 支持 usbStorage、airDrop、mobile、bluetooth
fields.name: device_type

fields.help_en: The file MD5 hash. This parameter is required when PolicyType is set to DlpSend. The value must be a 32-character hexadecimal string and is case-insensitive
fields.help_zh: 文件 MD5。当 PolicyType 取值为 DlpSend 时必填。取值必须为 32 位十六进制字符串，不区分大小写
fields.name: file_md5

fields.help_en: The filing domain name. This parameter is required when PolicyType is set to DomainWhitelist or DomainBlacklist. Regular domain names and wildcard domain names that start with *. are supported. Protocols, ports, and paths are not supported
fields.help_zh: 报备域名。当 PolicyType 取值为 DomainWhitelist 或 DomainBlacklist 时必填。支持普通域名或以 *. 开头的泛域名，不支持协议、端口和路径
fields.name: report_domain

fields.help_en: The peripheral filing granularity. This parameter is required when PolicyType is set to PeripheralBlock. Currently, only Channel is supported, which indicates filing by peripheral channel
fields.help_zh: 外设报备粒度。当 PolicyType 取值为 PeripheralBlock 时必填，当前仅支持 Channel，表示按外设渠道报备
fields.name: scope

fields.help_en: The blocked software ID. This parameter is required when PolicyType is set to SoftwareBlock
fields.help_zh: 禁用软件 ID。当 PolicyType 取值为 SoftwareBlock 时必填
fields.name: software_id

parameters.help_en: The list of filing objects, serialized in Flat format. You can specify 1 to 100 filing objects of the same policy type. The object fields must match the PolicyType value
parameters.help_zh: 报备对象列表，使用 Flat 序列化格式。支持 1~100 个同一策略类型的报备对象；对象字段必须与 PolicyType 匹配
parameters.name: report_objects

parameters.help_en:
The validity duration type. Default value: FixedTime. Valid values:
FixedTime: Expires at the specified time.
Permanent: Permanently valid
parameters.help_zh:
生效时长类型。不传时默认为 FixedTime。取值：
FixedTime：在指定时间失效。
Permanent：永久有效
parameters.name: validity_type

parameters.help_en: The filing expiration time as a UNIX timestamp in seconds. This parameter is required when ValidityType is set to FixedTime or ValidityType is not specified, and the value must be later than the current time. When ValidityType is set to Permanent, do not specify this parameter or set it to 0
parameters.help_zh: 报备截止时间，Unix 时间戳，单位为秒。当 ValidityType 取值为 FixedTime 或未传入 ValidityType 时必填，且必须晚于当前时间；当 ValidityType 取值为 Permanent 时请勿传入，或传入 0
parameters.name: end_timestamp

parameters.help_en: The filing reason. The value must be 1 to 1024 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 报备原因，1 至 1024 个字符
parameters.name: reason

FailedCount.description_en: The number of user-object combinations that failed to be created

Items.description_en: The processing results for each user-object combination. If some combinations fail, the operation still returns results for all combinations
Items.description_zh: 各“用户 × 报备对象”组合的处理结果。部分组合失败时，接口仍返回全部组合的结果

ApprovalId.description_en: The approval instance ID generated after a successful creation. This parameter is not returned if the creation fails
ApprovalId.description_zh: 创建成功后生成的审批实例 ID。创建失败时不返回

Code.description_en: The error code returned when the current combination fails to be created. This parameter is not returned if the creation succeeds
Code.description_zh: 当前组合创建失败时返回的错误码；成功时不返回

EffectStatus.description_en: The filing effective status. Enabled is returned when the creation succeeds, which indicates that the filing is valid
EffectStatus.description_zh: 报备生效状态。创建成功时返回 Enabled，表示有效

Message.description_en: The error message returned when the current combination fails to be created. This parameter is not returned if the creation succeeds
Message.description_zh: string当前组合创建失败时返回的错误信息；成功时不返回

ReportObject.description_en: The filing object corresponding to the current combination. The fields vary based on the PolicyType value
ReportObject.description_zh: 当前组合对应的报备对象，字段随 PolicyType 变化

ReportType.description_en: The filing type. BackendReport is always returned when the creation succeeds, which indicates a backend filing
ReportType.description_zh: 报备类型。创建成功时固定返回 BackendReport，表示后台报备

Status.description_en: The approval status. Approved is returned when the creation succeeds, which indicates that the filing is approved
Status.description_zh: 审批状态。创建成功时返回 Approved，表示已通过

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the current combination is created
Success.description_zh: 当前组合是否创建成功

Target.description_en: The filing user corresponding to the current combination
Target.description_zh: 当前组合对应的报备用户

ObjectCount.description_en: The number of deduplicated filing objects
ObjectCount.description_zh: 去重后的报备对象数量

SuccessCount.description_en: The number of user-object combinations that are created

TargetCount.description_en: The number of deduplicated filing users
TargetCount.description_zh: 去重后的报备用户数量

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of expanded user-object combinations
TotalCount.description_zh: 展开后的“用户 × 报备对象”组合总数
